name: Feature request

title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement

---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to the plugin.

## Motivation/Use Case

Why would this feature be useful? Please describe the use case or problem this feature would solve.

## Proposed Solution

Describe your preferred solution for implementing this feature. Include any technical details or implementation considerations you think are relevant.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Implementation Help

Are you willing to help implement this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a pull request
- [ ] No, I don't have the technical skills
- [ ] Maybe, I'd need some guidance
